pages.text: Returns your own error to the caller of the function.

The caller raises the error or stores it in the error label of its CALL line. $(1)code$() must be 1000 or higher, otherwise INVALID_ARGUMENT is raised. The error gets the context and line of the CALL statement.
$(li)$(1)code$() INTEGER: the error code, 1000 or higher$(li)$(1)message$() STRING: the error message (optional, default empty)
$(1)CALL RAISE$(br)  PARAMETER code 1001 ;$(br)  PARAMETER message "too big" ;$()
